name: What is the difference between built-in shelving and standalone custom shelving?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between built-in shelving and standalone custom shelving?

acceptedAnswer.text: Built-in shelving is designed to be a permanent fixture, integrated directly into the architectural structure of a room, often appearing seamless with walls or alcoves. This type of shelving offers a custom, tailored look and maximizes every inch of available space. Standalone custom shelving, while still bespoke, is a self-contained unit that is not permanently affixed to the building structure, offering more flexibility for relocation or rearrangement. The choice depends on whether you prioritize permanent integration and maximum space utilization or greater future adaptability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Built-in shelving is permanent and integrated into a room's architecture, maximizing space, while standalone custom shelving is a movable, self-contained unit.
